title: Customer reports suspected food contamination
facts_text: I verified my account and order. One dish has a strong unusual odor, and I am concerned it may not be safe to eat. I have not eaten it, and I did not take a photo.
request: Please tell me whether I should eat it and make sure the safety team reviews this report.

strict.reason: The customer reports a plausible safety concern, so advise against consumption and escalate without requiring a photo.
